newsitem.title: UK: Pace relocates UK reservations centre to Heathrow.
newsitem.headline: Pace relocates UK reservations centre to Heathrow.

text.p: Cargo and passenger airline general sales agents organisation, Pace Airline Services, is moving its Birmingham-based reservations, customer service centre and finance departments to its newly expanded headquarters at Heathrow.
"This additional expansion will also enable Pace to maintain its projected growth levels," said managing director Mac Warner.
Pace will continue to maintain sales offices in Birmingham and Manchester to promote airlines to forwarders throughout the UK.
Pace is GSA for Air China, Britannia Airways, Malev Hungarian Airlines, Ryanair, TAP, Ukraine International Airlines and United Airlines. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
